name: OpenCL-based Voxelization
definition: A parallelized voxelization algorithm using OpenCL that relies on a fast triangular mesh facet/cube overlapping test to compute intersections between triangular facets and a voxel grid.
summary: OpenCL-based Voxelization converts triangular meshes to voxel grids using parallel compute threads, achieving up to 260 times faster performance than CPU approaches by optimizing memory access patterns.
